'''Red Eyes''' (Japanese: '''レッドアイ''' ''Red Eye'') is one of the [[Pokémon Pinchers]] admins. He appears in [[Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs]].

==In the games==
Red Eyes first appears at the start of the game, shooting the player with his [[Z.Z. Flyer]]. He appears again at [[Rasp Cavern]], where he steals {{p|Raikou}}'s Emblem from the Involith. Red Eyes is responsible for the damage to the [[Big Booker Bridge]] using {{p|Electrode}} in an attempt to stop the player following him. Later, he contacts the player and [[Murph]] to offer to exchange [[Blue Eyes]] for the player's partner at [[Daybreak Ruins]], where he steals {{p|Entei}}'s Emblem in the involith. Red Eyes appears again at [[Faldera Volcano]], where he tries to awaken {{p|Moltres}} and battles the player with a {{p|Charizard}}. He appears again trying to awaken {{p|Articuno}} on [[Mt. Sorbet]], he challenges the player with a {{p|Typhlosion}}. Once Red Eyes is defeated, he leaves, his pride shattered. After the credits, during [[Supurna]]'s mission, he appears in the sky, and, holding the last piece of [[Edward]]'s [[Golden Armor]] and he challenges the player with a {{p|Blaziken}} on [[Mt. Sorbet]] for it. In his last appearance, during a quest, Red Eyes appears and hands the protagonist 2 out of 3 monument parts from the Involiths.

==In animation==
[[File:Red Eyes anime.png|thumb|250px|Red Eyes in {{OBP|Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs|animated special}}]]
===Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs===
Red Eyes debuted in ''[[Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs (animated special)#Part 1|Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs (Part 1)]]'', where he shot down {{ra|Ben}}. In [[Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs (animated special)#Part 2|the follow-up episode]], he unsuccessfully attempted to defeat Ben before deciding to take on the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Raikou}}.
